description: Create a contact named Northwind and see it in the kanban column new.
steps: Choose Ada as the acting user.
Create a contact named Northwind.
See Northwind in the kanban column new.

description: An empty contact name is refused and no contact is added.
steps: Choose Ada as the acting user.
Submit the create-contact form with an empty name.
See the error code contact.name.required.
See that no contact named with an empty name was added.

description: Qualifying Northwind moves that contact to the column qualified.
steps: Open the contact Northwind.
Fill email northwind@example.com and company Northwind.
Click Validate.
See the column qualified.

description: Sending an estimate moves Northwind to estimate sent and the page shows This is a test.
steps: On the qualified contact Northwind, set Cable quantity to 2 and Lamp quantity to 1.
See the grand total 25.
Click Validate estimate.
See the column estimate sent.
See the text This is a test.

description: Sending an estimate for a qualified contact with an empty email is refused and the column stays qualified.
steps: Open a qualified contact whose email is empty.
Add Cable quantity 2 and Lamp quantity 1 and click Validate estimate.
See the error code contact.email.required.
See that the column is still qualified.

description: Ada sees Northwind on the kanban, the contact list, and the estimate list. Ben does not.
steps: As Ada, create Northwind, qualify it, and send the estimate.
See Northwind on the kanban, the contact list, and the estimate list.
Choose Ben as the acting user.
See that Northwind is absent from the kanban, the contact list, and the estimate list.
